statement.p: Finally, find all critical points in the graph of f(x)

p.em: (Enter your x-values as a comma-separated list, or
if there are no critical points.)

static.solution: f'(x) > 0 and f'(x) \lt 0; critical points are where f'(x) = 0. Here f'(x) = -9 x^2 + 81 = -9 ( x - 3 )( x + 3 ), so f is increasing on (-3, 3) and decreasing on (-\infty, -3), (3, \infty). Critical points are x = -3 and x = 3.
